name: 休憩記録の内訳
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One Lighthouse LH11-0008 休憩記録の内訳 component. Image1 ORIGINAL Deputy source takes priority for icon geometry, proportions, alignment, spacing and fine controls; Image2 Japanese mock is secondary localized content/layout guidance. Image3 approved bus is only white/elevation style reference. Source's expanded break section has an UPWARD compact chevron and a small filled gray trash-bin action. Mock incorrectly points down and omits trash; correct those.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas and one compact white rounded section, fine neutral edge, quiet soft shadow. Logical640x168 at high resolution, wide/low composition without wasted height. Header left small bold 「休憩」 and adjacent regular summary 「食事休憩 30分」; right small UPWARD chevron in slate #526173 faithful to source. Below a wider white input labelled 「種類」 value 「食事休憩」, a narrower white input labelled 「時間」 value 「30分」 and small original-style filled slate trash glyph aligned at far right. Source proportions prioritize the type field (about70%) over duration (about20%), with remaining space for trash. Do not copy mock's equal-width split. Fine neutral control outlines, softly rounded corners. Bottom two forest-green text links 「休憩を追加」「時刻を設定」 aligned left.
Preserve all existing Japanese text/30-minute value and expanded state; add only the original omitted trash control. No invented rows, times, metrics, primary button or icons. Meiryo header14/24bold, summary12/16regular, body14/24regular, metadata12/16regular, zero tracking. Keep original restrained small icon optical weight and clean baselines. Original purple links become #1F6444 forest green, utility chevron/bin slate, all ordinary surfaces white. No semantic status in this isolated section so no extra accents or gradient action are needed. No mint, lavender, colored form icons, heavy nested cards, English chrome or surrounding timesheet. Static raster design candidate only.
reviewNotes: 日本語と30分/二リンク、展開上向き、原画の欄比率と削除操作を保持。生成された上シェブロン/削除記号が原画より大きく、削除箱内部の溝が省略されているため要修正。紫リンクは森林緑、他スレート。画像レビューの修正待ち、所有者承認等なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
